From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finbank.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finbank.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo - FinBank

Hi Priya / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today - really helpful to understand FinBank's priorities around secure, low-latency inference for customer support and transaction monitoring. Quick recap and proposed next step:

- Recap: you're focused on lowering per-token cost while keeping sub-200ms P95 for short responses, and you need a path for private deployment (VPC) + SOC2 evidence.
- Next step: 30-min product demo (high-level product + short technical deep-dive) aimed at your platform + security stakeholders.

Can you confirm which of these windows works for your team (all times PT):
1) Wed Apr 1 - 10:00-10:30 AM PT
2) Thu Apr 2 - 2:00-2:30 PM PT
3) Fri Apr 3 - 11:30-12:00 PM PT

If none work, happy to send a Calendly link instead: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30. Also, please let me know who from your side should join (platform lead, security, SRE - typically 2-3 people).

Attaching a short one-pager with my discovery notes for reference.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: Discovery-Notes.pdf (1 page)
